Sherlock Holmes - Consulting Detective.name: Sherlock Holmes: Consulting Detective
Sherlock Holmes - Consulting Detective.summary: A FMV update to the classic book-based game, SH:CD challenges players to help Holmes and Watson solve three cases involving murder. One of the first CD-ROM-only releases.

Tengai Makyou - Deden no Den.name: Tengai Makyou: Deden no Den
Tengai Makyou - Deden no Den.summary: A version of Bomberman '94 themed after the Tengai Makyou series that was released as a promotional item in Hudson's newsletter.
